en.title: Can Claude Make Videos? Claude Motion vs Skills (2026)
en.description: Claude makes video by writing code. Compare Claude Motion, HyperFrames skills and Remotion skills by plan, output, files and licence, as of November 2026.
en.lede: Yes. Claude makes video by writing code that a renderer turns into an MP4 file, and Anthropic's Claude Motion article says the feature uses no video generation model. As of November 2026 there are three routes: Claude Motion on Team and Enterprise plans, HyperFrames skills in Claude Code or Codex, and Remotion skills. This page compares them and shows real output.

blocks.text: How Claude makes a video

Anthropic's help article for Claude Motion states that the feature does not use a video generation model, so it cannot create realistic footage or people. It generates code that animates text, charts, shapes and images, and the result plays like a short video. The other two routes work the same way. Claude writes project files, a renderer draws each frame, and an encoder produces the MP4.
Three ways to make a video with Claude
The table compares the three routes as of 16 November 2026. Each cell comes from the official page listed under Sources.

blocks.text: Claude Motion

Claude Motion is Anthropic's feature for short animations, described in a help article dated 8 October 2026. You ask for one in any chat, choose Motion under Output in the message box, or start from a Motion template in the Artifacts tab. The article recommends stating the audience, where the video will be shown and the approximate length, and attaching the data or images to use.

Changes go through chat, such as adjusting timing or updating a figure, or through the editor. New animations are private until you share them. Owners and Primary Owners switch the feature on or off under Organization settings, in the Artifacts section.
HyperFrames skills in Claude Code or Codex

HyperFrames is HeyGen's free, open-source framework that turns HTML, CSS, media and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos. GSAP is its primary animation runtime. For Claude Code, the HyperFrames docs give a plugin install, and `npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes` installs the skills for other agents. The repository lists nine skills, and the core set covers the main skill, the CLI, a registry of about 450 blocks, media, reverse-engineering a video into a project, and style sampling.

The HyperFrames site also lists a hosted connector for Claude, ChatGPT and Grok chat, in beta, where videos render in the cloud under a HeyGen account. A launch video built this way is covered in [product launch video with Claude Code](/guides/product-launch-video-with-claude-code/).
Remotion skills

Remotion is a React framework for making videos with code. Its official agent skills install with `npx skills add remotion-dev/skills`, or with `npx remotion skills add` inside a project. The Remotion docs list Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kimi Code and OpenCode as supported agents. The licence terms for companies are explained in [HyperFrames vs Remotion](/guides/hyperframes-vs-remotion/). A longer list of video skills is in [Claude Code video skills](/guides/claude-code-video-skills/).
Where Motionboard fits

Motionboard is a free, MIT-licensed site and skill with 48 shot recipes taken from launch films by Apple, Linear and others. Each recipe is a film of about 10 seconds at 1920x1080, made in code with HyperFrames and shown next to the original clip. The skill runs in Claude Code and Codex with Node.js 22+ and FFmpeg installed, on whatever plan or account those agents use. The files are plain HTML in your project folder and render on your own computer.
Real output from Claude Code and Codex
These four recipe films were made with HyperFrames. Each recipe page shows the film next to the original clip.
Try it
Run this in your video project folder, then ask Claude Code or Codex for a recipe by its effect name, such as a match cut transition or a typing animation.
npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard
Frequently asked questions

items: Can Claude generate video from a prompt like Sora?

Anthropic's Claude Motion article says the feature does not use a video generation model and cannot create realistic footage or people. Claude produces animations from code: text, charts, shapes and images that are timed and rendered to MP4.
Is Claude Motion free?

The help article lists Claude Motion as a beta on Team and Enterprise plans and gives no separate price. Generating or editing animations counts toward the plan's usage limits, and longer or more complex animations use more of the limit. Check the article for changes in plan availability.
Can Claude Code edit an existing video?

The HyperFrames README lists a skill named reverse-any-video that rebuilds a video file as an editable HyperFrames project, marked as HyperFrames Pro, and a skill named remotion-to-hyperframes that brings existing video code or footage into HyperFrames. Claude Motion edits animations created in Claude, by chat or in its editor.
Do I need a HeyGen account to use HyperFrames?

The HyperFrames FAQ says an account is not needed to make and render videos on your computer. An account is needed for HeyGen voices and music, avatars, cloud rendering, the hosted connector and the Studio app.
Can I use videos made with HyperFrames commercially?

The HyperFrames FAQ says the Apache 2.0 licence allows commercial use under its terms, and that media you add, such as fonts, music or footage, keeps its own licence. Motionboard recipes are MIT-licensed.

zh.title: Claude 能做视频吗？Claude Motion 与技能对比（2026）
zh.description: Claude 靠写代码做视频。对比 Claude Motion、HyperFrames 与 Remotion 技能的套餐、输出和许可证（2026 年 11 月）。
zh.lede: 能。Claude 通过写代码做视频，由渲染器把代码变成 MP4 文件，Anthropic 的 Claude Motion 说明文章也写明该功能没有使用视频生成模型。截至 2026 年 11 月有三条路线：Team 和 Enterprise 套餐里的 Claude Motion、Claude Code 或 Codex 里的 HyperFrames 技能，以及 Remotion 技能。本文逐项对比，并展示真实成片。

blocks.text: Claude 如何做出视频
Anthropic 的 Claude Motion 帮助文章写明，该功能没有使用视频生成模型，因此无法生成真实画面或真人。它生成的是让文字、图表、形状和图片动起来的代码，结果像一段短视频一样播放。另外两条路线的原理相同：Claude 写出项目文件，渲染器逐帧绘制，编码器输出 MP4。
用 Claude 做视频的三种方式
下表按 2026 年 11 月 16 日的信息对比三条路线，每个单元格都来自文末列出的官方页面。

head: Claude Motion
HyperFrames 技能
Remotion 技能

blocks.text: Claude Motion
Claude Motion 是 Anthropic 推出的短动画功能，帮助文章日期为 2026 年 10 月 8 日。你可以在任意对话里提出需求，也可以在输入框的 Output 中选择 Motion，或从 Artifacts 标签页的 Motion 模板开始。文章建议写明受众、播放场景和大致时长，并附上要用的数据或图片。
修改可以通过对话完成，例如调整节奏或更新数字，也可以在编辑器里改。新动画默认私有，分享后他人才能看到。Owner 和 Primary Owner 可以在 Organization settings 的 Artifacts 部分开启或关闭该功能。
Claude Code 或 Codex 里的 HyperFrames 技能

HyperFrames 是 HeyGen 的免费开源框架，把 HTML、CSS、媒体和可定位的动画渲染成确定性的 MP4 视频，主要动画运行时是 GSAP。HyperFrames 文档为 Claude Code 提供了插件安装方式，其他 agent 可以用 `npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes` 安装技能。仓库列出九个技能，核心技能包括主技能、CLI、约 450 个模块的注册表、媒体处理、把视频还原成项目，以及风格采样。
HyperFrames 网站还列出了面向 Claude、ChatGPT 和 Grok 聊天的托管连接器（beta），视频在 HeyGen 账号下的云端渲染。用这条路线做发布视频的方法见[用 Claude Code 做产品发布视频](/guides/product-launch-video-with-claude-code/)。
Remotion 技能

Remotion 是用代码做视频的 React 框架。它的官方 agent 技能可以用 `npx skills add remotion-dev/skills` 安装，在项目内也可以用 `npx remotion skills add`。Remotion 文档列出的受支持 agent 包括 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Kimi Code 和 OpenCode。公司使用的许可证条款见 [HyperFrames 与 Remotion 对比](/guides/hyperframes-vs-remotion/)。更多视频技能见 [Claude Code 视频技能](/guides/claude-code-video-skills/)。
Motionboard 的位置

Motionboard 是免费、MIT 许可的站点和技能，收录 48 个取自 Apple、Linear 等发布会影片的镜头配方。每个配方是一支约 10 秒、1920x1080 的影片，用 HyperFrames 以代码制作，并与原片并排展示。技能在 Claude Code 和 Codex 里运行，装好 Node.js 22+ 和 FFmpeg 即可，套餐取决于这些 agent 所用的账号。文件是项目文件夹里的普通 HTML，在你自己的电脑上渲染。
Claude Code 和 Codex 的真实成片
下面四支配方影片都用 HyperFrames 制作，每个配方页面都把影片与原片并排展示。
动手试试
在你的视频项目文件夹里运行下面的命令，然后让 Claude Code 或 Codex 按效果名称生成配方，例如匹配剪辑转场或打字动画。
npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard
常见问题

items: Claude 能像 Sora 那样根据提示词生成视频吗？
Anthropic 的 Claude Motion 文章写明，该功能没有使用视频生成模型，无法生成真实画面或真人。Claude 用代码生成动画：文字、图表、形状和图片经过排时间后渲染成 MP4。
Claude Motion 免费吗？
帮助文章把 Claude Motion 列为 Team 和 Enterprise 套餐中的 beta 功能，没有给出单独价格。生成或编辑动画会计入套餐的用量上限，更长或更复杂的动画消耗更多额度。套餐范围可能变化，请以文章为准。
Claude Code 能编辑已有的视频吗？
HyperFrames 的 README 列出了 reverse-any-video 技能，可把视频文件还原成可编辑的 HyperFrames 项目（标注为 HyperFrames Pro），还有 remotion-to-hyperframes 技能，可把已有的视频代码或素材带入 HyperFrames。Claude Motion 编辑的是在 Claude 里创建的动画，通过对话或编辑器修改。
使用 HyperFrames 需要 HeyGen 账号吗？
HyperFrames FAQ 写明，在自己的电脑上制作和渲染视频不需要账号。使用 HeyGen 的配音和音乐、数字人、云端渲染、托管连接器和 Studio 应用时需要账号。
用 HyperFrames 做的视频可以商用吗？
HyperFrames FAQ 写明，Apache 2.0 许可证在其条款下允许商用，你添加的字体、音乐或素材保留各自的许可证。Motionboard 配方采用 MIT 许可。
